note: Non-membership family campground on 77 acres near Merrill: 4-acre dug swim lake with sandy beach, camper-only mini-waterpark, two catch-and-release fishing ponds, themed weekends. Open mid-April to early October. Mostly seasonal: the 2023 park map marks about 84 of ~250 lots as nightly camping lots, the rest seasonal. --Claude
summary: Operator site (2026): $40 a night with one car pass, monthly $600 + electric, seasonal by phone; 253 sites all water/electric (map shows 50-amp lots), 2 bathhouses with free showers, 2 dump stations, camp store; opens April 15, 2026; reservations required, by phone/email (no engine). Confirmed fees; added electric 50, count 250 -> 253, showers/store, opening date, booking by phone. Non-membership stated ('NON-MEMBERSHIP CAMPGROUND!').
flags: Long-stay check: mostly seasonal in character. The 2023 park map (on the home page) colours about 84 lots grey 'Camping Lots' and about 165 'Seasonal Lots'/50-amp lots, so roughly a third are sold nightly; the site holds an 'annual seasonal information meeting' and golf carts are 'for seasonal campers ONLY'. Passes test 4 (well over 1 in 10 nightly) and test 2 (posted $40 nightly rate); membership: 'NON-MEMBERSHIP CAMPGROUND!'.
No online booking engine: reservations are required and taken by phone/email only. Presence: working website with phone 989-643-0403.
Price gate: $40 a night (2026), under US$50.
